sources.claim: Picsou/C3B uses quorum acknowledgements to determine message receipt/loss and reduce retransmission overhead between replicated state machines.
sources.source: USENIX OSDI 2025 - Picsou: Enabling Replicated State Machines to Communicate Efficiently
sources.transfer_to_clay: Supports precise delivery-state/repair accounting as a design analogy; does not validate Clay branch ACK semantics, epistemic quorum, or agent routing quality.

sources.claim: Enzyme is a production incremental-view-maintenance engine using a cost-based optimization layer to select refresh strategies and exploit batching opportunities.
sources.source: arXiv:2603.27775 v2 / SIGMOD Companion 2026 - Enzyme: Incremental View Maintenance for Data Engineering
sources.transfer_to_clay: Supports measuring adaptive refresh/batching rather than fixing one refresh cadence; does not validate UnifiedDB/ClayGraph semantics or V3 routing.

sources.claim: T2C derives runtime semantic checkers from tests and detected 15/20 reproduced real-world silent failures across four distributed systems with small runtime overhead.
sources.source: USENIX OSDI 2025 - Deriving Semantic Checkers from Tests to Detect Silent Failures in Production Distributed Systems
sources.transfer_to_clay: Supports explicit semantic runtime checkers such as stale epoch/route/replay invariants; does not prove those checkers are sufficient for Clay or that transport success implies semantic correctness.

counterevidence_and_limits: Picsou assumes replicated-state-machine communication and quorum structure; Clay workers are heterogeneous research processes and ACK count must not become evidence strength.
Enzyme optimizes relational/materialized-view refresh; transfer to live knowledge/worker routing is architectural analogy only and requires Clay-specific cost/consistency measurements.
T2C reports incomplete detection (15/20 reproduced silent failures), so semantic checkers reduce but do not eliminate silent failure risk.
None of the three sources provides evidence that V3 dual-plane branch beacons outperform V2 on the actual Clay repository or active workers.
architecture_delta: NO_DIRECT_PROMOTION. Retain precise ACK/repair, cost-based refresh/batching and semantic checker ideas as falsifiable implementation patterns; require actual repo/worker A/B before selecting V3.
